aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for Ask AI.
issues: Changed factor is polluted with totals, dates, row numbers, and class labels.
Function comparisons mix aggregate Normal with individual test rows and omit later cited rows.
Process and class-yoke sections are outcomes under recycled-yoke validation, not changed conditions.
Measurement outcomes are extraction artifacts from headers and should not be evidence.
Key evidence rows for Jan 21-22 and Normal subrows are omitted from function grouping.
correctionPlan: Set primary factor to Normal yoke vs recycled/test yoke use.
Keep date/test round as subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
Use aggregate rows for main function comparison and separate per-round rows consistently.
Retain process vision and class-yoke results as descriptive outcomes only if row evidence supports them.
Remove header-derived measurement outcomes and add missing relevant function rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are incomplete and misgrouped.
